**In one line**: CNBC reports that AI safety evaluators, which have mostly worked out of public view, are drawing more attention across the industry.

### Key points
- According to CNBC, the "safety gatekeepers" who check AI models for risk before release are stepping into the spotlight.
- This kind of work usually means pre-release model evaluation, red teaming (testing models against attack scenarios), and measuring dangerous capabilities.
- Readers should check the original article for the specific organizations and figures it names. This digest is based on headline-level information.

### Why it matters
As frontier models get more capable, the questions of who decides a model is safe, and by what standard, increasingly shape release schedules and regulatory compliance. If evaluators gain standing, pre-release testing becomes more likely to turn into an industry norm.
